prompts.prompt: What is the official race distance of the marathon, in kilometres?
prompts.scope: The official distance set by World Athletics, in kilometres (not miles).

hint.text: The distance became official in 1921 and is also the figure printed on race signage and finish-line clocks.

reveal.explanation: The official marathon distance is 42.195 km — set when the 1908 London course was later standardised.

prompts.prompt: Roughly how many loaves of sandwich bread could you make from the wheat grown on one acre, using the fixture yield and a 500 g flour recipe? (The fixture uses 2,800 kg of wheat per acre, 0.72 kg of flour recovered per kg of wheat, and 0.5 kg of flour per loaf.)
prompts.scope: Demonstration fixture with declared assumptions: 2,800 kg wheat per acre, 72% extraction, 500 g flour per loaf.

steps: One acre yields 2,800 kg of wheat (declared fixture assumption).
Each loaf takes 0.5 kg of flour: 2,016 ÷ 0.5 = 4,032 loaves. Worked estimate: 4,032 loaves.

reveal.explanation: 2,800 kg × 0.72 ÷ 0.5 = 4,032 loaves per acre under the declared assumptions.

prompts.prompt: How many steps would a representative runner take in a 10 km road race? The fixture assumes a 1.15 m step length.
prompts.scope: Representative runner model: 10 km at a 1.15 m step length.

inputs.name: distance
inputs.assumption: Race distance given in the prompt.

steps: Round to a representative benchmark. Worked estimate: 8,700 steps.

prompts.prompt: How many sheets of standard office paper, stacked flat, would reach the top of the Burj Khalifa? The fixture uses a height of 828 m and a ream of 500 sheets about 5 cm thick.
prompts.scope: Declared fixture paper specification: 0.05 m per 500-sheet ream (0.1 mm per sheet).

figure.scope: Thickness of the fixture’s standard office ream

prompts.prompt: Name a feature film whose original theatrical runtime is closest to 120 minutes.
prompts.scope: Starter dataset: the fixture collection of ten films with original theatrical runtimes.

reveal.explanation: Your film’s runtime is compared against the target; the dataset’s closest eligible entries are shown.
